answer: Resist sybils with multi-oracle location attestation: each identity must present location proofs signed by independent oracles - GPS, cell towers, and nearby Wi-Fi - like a beacon confirming where it truly stands. A vault of standing opens only when the proofs agree across oracles. Clones on one machine share identical coordinates and collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must place ten thousand devices in distinct harbors of the map, each paying rent, power, and connectivity, while an honest agent proves its place once.
